definitions.explanation: A medical device or procedure for delivering fluids or medication directly into a vein through a tube.

examples.japanese: {点滴|てんてき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{脱水症状|だっすいしょうじょう}→脱水症状：30114_dassuishoujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{点滴|てんてき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: I was put on an IV drip due to dehydration.

examples.japanese: {入院中|にゅういんちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{点滴|てんてき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けなければ→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦ならなかった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: During my hospital stay, I had to receive an IV drip every day.

notes:
USAGE:
The most common verbs used with {点滴|てんてき} are ⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive) and ⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ (to administer/get). In casual speech, {点滴|てんてき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ is used from the patient's perspective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {点滴|てんてき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive an IV drip
- {点滴|てんてき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to get an IV drip
- {点滴|てんてき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in an IV
- {点滴|てんてき}⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧: intravenous injection

ETYMOLOGY:
Literally "drip by drop" — ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (drop/point) + ⟦{滴|てき}→〜滴：04014_teki⟧ (drip/drop).
